_comment: Copy this to `ecosine-team.json` and list the people who fill in a daily sheet. `ecosine-team.json` is git-ignored — real colleagues' names do not belong in a public repository. Read fresh whenever a report runs, so an edit takes effect without a restart. Missing file means no daily reporters, which is a working state: the weekly report simply has no daily section.

daily_reporters.name: Their first name — also the folder name under the agent who follows them up
daily_reporters.role: Their job title, shown as the heading above their section

daily_reporters.name: Someone whose sheet you do not want make-report-templates.py to create by default
